claims.description: US_COPPA explicitly resolves to and persists coppa_parental_consent.
EU_GDPR_13, EU_GDPR_14, EU_GDPR_15, and EU_GDPR_16 explicitly resolve to gdpr_parental_consent.
UK_AADC explicitly resolves to and persists gdpr_parental_consent.
ROW and unknown regimes reject before Guardianship or consent writes survive the transaction.
The resolver has no permissive default, so a new or null regime cannot silently inherit a lawful basis.
